summary: Frontend-only regression testing passed for the requested portfolio portrait, responsive layout, navigation, project two-click interaction, CTA, email, close controls, overflow, and console-error checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified public preview at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. Portrait rendered, first project click previewed without overlay, second click opened case study, close button and backdrop closed it, CTA navigation and email href were correct, mobile menu opened/closed, document width matched viewport, and no page error messages or console errors were observed. Backend intentionally skipped; no APIs mocked.
rca of the issue: Prior iteration's interaction bug is resolved by separate expandedProject and activeProject state. The one failed rerun was caused by clicking a row twice after closing while expandedProject remained selected; the correct next click opens the overlay.
